'''Sybaine Aldwyn''' is one of the thirteen [[Counsel]]s of [[Far Madding]].

==Apperance==
She has gray hair.

==Activities==
She is among the rest of the Counsels in meet over the fate of [[Rand al'Thor]] when [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] bursts in and demands on Rand's release.
